Author: Ambuj Nath

 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 A.B.A No. 5140 of 2023
 Enjoy Hans @ Hiro Hans --- --- Petitioner
 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. The State of Jharkhand
 2. Prakash Kujur --- --- Opp. Parties
 ---
Coram: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

--- 
For the Petitioner: Ms. Diksha Dwivedi, Advocate For the O.P-State:

Mr. Pankaj Kumar, P.P.
---
08 / 13.06.2024 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Chutia P.S. Case No. 126 of 2022 for the offences registered under sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471, 341, 323 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Sri Shambhu Mahto, learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi.
3.
Earlier, the matter was referred to JHALSA for mediation.
Report has been received from the Member Secretary, JHALSA stating that the parties have already settled the dispute.
4. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the learned court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender, shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Shambhu Mahto, learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi in connection with Chutia P.S. Case No. 126 of 2022,
subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Ambuj Nath, J) Ranjeet/ Uploaded Enjoy Hans @ Hiro Hans vs The State Of Jharkhand on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105075342/
